prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a steady advance along a snow-covered slope on the Mardi Himal Trail in Kaski, Nepal. The camera moves forward, capturing the pristine white snow underfoot, which glistens under the bright daylight. As the viewer progresses, the camera angle shifts slightly upward, revealing rugged mountain peaks in the distance, their rocky surfaces partially covered with patches of snow. The surrounding environment is serene and untouched, with no signs of human presence, emphasizing the trail's isolation. The camera continues its forward motion, occasionally panning to the left and right, showcasing the expansive snowy landscape and the intricate textures of the terrain. The sky above is clear and blue, casting sharp shadows that enhance the three-dimensional quality of the scene. The movement remains smooth and consistent, providing an immersive experience of navigating through this majestic, snowy wilderness. The natural light highlights the varying shades of white and gray, creating a visually striking contrast between the snow and the rocky outcrops. As the journey continues, the camera captures the subtle undulations of the trail, offering a detailed view of the natural beauty and tranquility of the Mardi Himal region.
